# Phase Two — Realistic Architecture and File Map

Chesed expands the movie language; Gevurah guards each engine's border. Tiferes joins them through a small contract in proper order.

## Shared Core — New Files
Target folder: `apps/shared/movie/`
- `MovieProtocol.js` — protocol/version constants and document factory.
- `MovieKinds.js` — scene/layer/camera/transition/animation kind vocabulary.
- `MovieCapabilities.js` — discoverable common and per-app capability descriptors.
- `MovieValidator.js` — structural and timeline validation with actionable errors.
- `MovieNormalizer.js` — safe defaults, stable IDs, duration/frame normalization.
- `MovieClock.js` — scene lookup/local time/frame sampling helpers.
- `MovieKeyframes.js` — deterministic keyframe interpolation/easing.
- `AiMovieContract.js` — AI-facing schema/manifest/example guidance as data.
- `index.js` — stable public imports.

## Adapter Targets — Prefer New Files
- `apps/animator/src/movie/AnimatorMovieAdapter.js`
- `apps/captions/video/modules/movie/CaptionMovieAdapter.js`
- `apps/nesher-studio/modules/movie/NesherMovieAdapter.js`
Each adapter returns explicit supported/unsupported layer information instead of silently dropping intent.

## Mobile AI Surface — Conditional
If clean entry hooks exist:
- `apps/shared/movie/ui/MovieDock.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ui/movie-dock.css`
The dock must be thumb-friendly, bottom-sheet oriented, narrow-screen safe, keyboard accessible, and themeable by app identity.

## Showcase — New Files
- `apps/shared/movie/examples/ThreeMinuteMovie.js` — deterministic 180-second document generator.
- `apps/shared/movie/examples/ThreeMinuteScenes.js` — scene list factory if line count requires split.
- `apps/shared/movie/examples/ThreeMinuteCast.js` — recurring character definitions.

## Verification — New Files
- `apps/shared/movie/tests/movieProtocolSmoke.mjs`
- `apps/shared/movie/tests/threeMinuteShowcaseSmoke.mjs`
- app-specific adapter smoke tests near each adapter if test conventions permit.

## Integration Rule
Do not modify Animator files already dirty from another agent unless a fresh hash/read proves a stable, conflict-free extension seam. Standalone importable adapters are acceptable evidence of unification; invasive integration is not worth destroying concurrent work.

## Data Shape
A movie has protocol/version, metadata, format, duration, fps, reusable assets/cast, scenes, and optional handoff metadata. A scene has start/duration, camera, layers, transition, and cues. A layer has kind, start/duration, transform/style/content/data/keyframes and renderer hints. Unknown keys are preserved where safe.

## Verification Graph
Document -> normalize -> validate -> sample timeline -> adapter capability report -> app-native conversion -> browser preview -> export -> ffprobe -> representative-frame/console review.
